name: Hanweir Battlements
clause: {3}{R}{R}, {T}: If you both own and control ~ and a creature named Hanweir Garrison, exile them, then meld them into Hanweir, the Writhing Township.

needs.proposedSignature: effect { op: 'meld'; with: Filter; into: string }  +  condition { kind: 'owns-and-controls'; filter: Filter }
needs.semantics: CR 701.39: if the controller both owns and controls the source and a permanent matching `with`, exile both and put the meld card named `into` onto the battlefield under that player's control, melded face up; otherwise nothing happens. The condition is the intervening-if / activation guard these cards print ('If you both own and control ~ and a creature named X'). Needs the card database to resolve the meld result by name, the way `transform` resolves a back face.
needs.clause: At the beginning of your end step, if you both own and control ~ and a creature named Bruna, the Fading Light, exile them, then meld them into Brisela, Voice of Nightmares.
